narrative: Demand for PL1__ME8381E8 is erratic (CV=0.238) with near-universal daily presence (99.4% non-zero) and no detectable trend over the March 2025–March 2026 observation window. Lead times average 1.19 days but exhibit moderate instability (CV=0.875), with supplier variability accounting for 84.5% of lead-time variance. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy is recommended: the EOQ-derived order quantity of 30,503 units dramatically reduces annual ordering frequency from ~1,170 to ~125 orders, while the analytically derived safety stock of 26,885 units properly covers combined demand and lead-time uncertainty to achieve the 95% service level. The total storage requirement of 57,388 units utilises only 18.5% of the 310,579-unit capacity.
warnings: Safety stock recommendation differs from SAP by +171.5%; increase is analytically justified by erratic demand and moderate lead-time variability.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is near-continuous (99.4% non-zero days) with erratic but not intermittent pattern, making a continuous-review reorder-point model appropriate. EOQ provides the cost-minimising order quantity while the combined-variance safety stock formula correctly accounts for both demand and lead-time uncertainty.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage constraint does not bind (18.5% utilisation). No capacity-driven risk identified. MOQ of 3,268 is well below the EOQ of 30,503, so the MOQ constraint is non-binding.
